discovery Block in harness.config.json
nodes.rationale: Optional discovery.skills/mcp arrays declare which tools the harness depends on, enabling deterministic list/find/check verification; schema-first because additionalProperties:false rejects undeclared keys.

nodes.label: Semantic Platform Discovery vs Deterministic Harness Contract
nodes.rationale: Skill triggering (description matching) and tool_search similarity remain platform heuristics; the harness can only declare intent and verify presence - it wraps semantic discovery in a declared, verifiable contract without replacing it.
